message.text:
Initial grep results for NATS, RabbitMQ, and AMQP were false positives in Spanish and Catalan locale files.

The repository is a Memos note-taking app. Webhook delivery uses an in-memory buffered channel named `asyncPostQueue` declared in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` at line 39. Four goroutine workers consume from this channel, started in `init()` at lines 42–54. Producers call `webhook.PostAsync()` from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. Neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used anywhere in this repository.
